notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5886 and PB5891): §2023:15.3 AR6 'An arithmetic expression that will always result in an integer value or an integer data item shall be specified' (cite.py OK). The rule sets no method of proof. The type 6 classifier FAILS CLOSED and decides EXACTLY (IntegerViolation's expression arm, NotAlwaysIntegral, the one answer IsAlwaysIntegral; docs/INTRINSICS_DESIGN.md, the type-6 intake): it builds the argument's value as a polynomial with rational coefficients in its atoms (Build: a fixed-point item is 10^-scale times an integer atom keyed by its place, subscripts included; an integer-type function, an index-name, a counter register and an ODO extent are integer atoms; a floating-point item and a numeric function are real atoms; two references are one atom only when they are the same pure term, SameTerm, and a function whose value its arguments do not fix, IntrinsicSig.ValueSource, never is; a quotient by a nonzero literal is the product by its reciprocal; a quotient by anything else is refused). Every intermediate must be exact (Intermediate: no real monomial, a quotient within the 14 guard digits a nested quotient keeps, an integer on the binary64 lane, the significant digits of a standard arithmetic), and the polynomial must be integer-valued: Polynomial.FractionDigits is 0, decided exactly on the grid {0..d_i} of its degrees (cap: degree 12 per atom, 4096 points). Admitted: N * (N + 1) / 2, N * (N + 1) * (N + 2) / 6, SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5, 0 * SQRT (N) + 5 (also under STANDARD-DECIMAL), WN / 2 * 2, S * 10. Refused with COBOL1627: FUNCTION ORD (A) / 2, N * (N + 1) / 3, a quotient by an item (I / I), WN / 3 * 3, a power with an exponent that can be negative, RANDOM - RANDOM + 1 (impure), (N ** 13 - N) / 13 (past the cap), T (1) - T (2) over a scaled table, and S2 - FUNCTION MAX (S2) over a scaled S2 (two atoms equal only by MAX's meaning, the residue of kb/Work PB5889). The same classifier answers the argument types of the functions whose type depends on them (IsIntegerArgument; IntegralForm gives such an argument its scale-0 value through INTEGER-PART). Witnesses: the pb5886-* and pb5891-* refusals, the complements pb5891_polynomial_integer_arguments, pb5891_standard_decimal_identity, pb5886_integer_term_shapes, pb5832_scaled_integral_shapes, pb124_always_integral_zoo, pb617_integer_arg_literal_constant, the unit shape table IntrinsicTypeSixPowerShapesDriftTests, ArgumentPolynomialTests, IntrinsicValueSourceDriftTests and IntegerArgumentConstantWitnessTests. retired-witness: conformance:cases/15.3-Arguments/pb5889-identity-difference (kb/Work PB5891: the type 6 classifier decides by a polynomial normal form; CollectAdditive is deleted, NotAlwaysIntegral moved to IntrinsicArgumentRules.TypeSix.cs, and pb5889-identity-difference's program (SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5) is now admitted, carried by pb5891_polynomial_integer_arguments) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#CollectAdditive (kb/Work PB5891: the type 6 classifier decides by a polynomial normal form; CollectAdditive is deleted, NotAlwaysIntegral moved to IntrinsicArgumentRules.TypeSix.cs, and pb5889-identity-difference's program (SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5) is now admitted, carried by pb5891_polynomial_integer_arguments) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#NotAlwaysIntegral (kb/Work PB5891: the type 6 classifier decides by a polynomial normal form; CollectAdditive is deleted, NotAlwaysIntegral moved to IntrinsicArgumentRules.TypeSix.cs, and pb5889-identity-difference's program (SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5) is now admitted, carried by pb5891_polynomial_integer_arguments)
